title: GP - Updates 202607
summary: The GP migration now spreads item transactions across multiple batches instead of one and supports more custom G/L account expense categories. Validation is corrected for payment terms, POs split over multiple lines, and Code/Text type mismatches, and the account beginning balance validation is removed for now.
key_points: Item transactions are distributed across multiple batches instead of a single batch
Support added for additional custom G/L account expense categories
Validation fixed for payment terms and for POs whose items are split over multiple lines
Code versus Text type mismatches in validation corrected, for example postal code
Account beginning balance validation removed pending a redesign
quote: A single item batch was being created, when transactions should have been distributed among multiple
